name: Flying Rats
body:
“Bats are just rats with wings! Disgusting, uncultured, vermin!”

“Hey, as a Stirgi, I resemble that remark!”

Prerequisite(s): Fly (5 ranks), stirgi

Benefit(s): You gain a fly speed equal to your base land speed with average maneuverability. A stirgi who hasn’t feed in 24 hours loses this benefit.
